claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting implicit discourse relations, with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing Comparison and Temporal relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 points and 7 points respectively.
The model's performance for explicit discourse relations is also improved, but it is not as high as for implicit relations, indicating it works better for implicit relations overall.
